TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms compliance with the Energy Department, Government of Punjab’s requirements for design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of grid-tied Solar PV systems totaling 5 MW across twelve public hospitals, including three (3) years of operations and maintenance from commissioning (as specified in the RFP). We have delivered multiple Solar Energy deployments, including for Provincial Government and Federal Government clients, meeting the RFP’s minimum project experience threshold [CAP-008][CAP-020]. We also have demonstrated delivery to government clients in Pakistan through completed Provincial and Federal Government engagements [CAP-008][CAP-020].

We hold ISO 9001 as required [CO-PROFILE], and can provide bid security in the form of a bank guarantee from a scheduled bank within our established facility limit [CO-PROFILE]. We are SECP incorporated and FBR registered with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status [CO-PROFILE].

For mandatory technical scope, we will supply Tier-1 PV modules, string inverters, and mounting structures, execute civil/electrical works, and ensure compliance with IEC 62548 and the Pakistan Electricity Code (commitment per RFP). Site surveys and detailed engineering design are marked PARTIAL; we will complete surveys and designs for each hospital using our in-house PE-registered engineers and multi-city delivery presence (Islamabad HQ, Lahore, Karachi) [CO-PROFILE].

SCADA/central dashboard is PARTIAL; we will integrate SCADA/IoT monitoring leveraging our network design delivery experience and ISO 9001-governed processes [CAP-045][CO-PROFILE]. Comprehensive O&M with performance guarantees is PARTIAL; our support model evidences 24–48h response SLAs and quarterly preventive maintenance on O&M contracts, which we will align to the RFP’s guarantee format [CO-PROFILE].

The sole GAP is in-house grid interconnection studies and protection coordination (T3). Our library does not yet evidence this capability; we will close it by engaging a specialized protection/interconnection studies partner under our ISO 9001 controls and by assigning internal PE-registered engineers for interface and review [CO-PROFILE]. PMP requirement (M5) is PARTIAL: we have PMP-certified project managers in-house and will nominate a PM meeting the RFP’s experience threshold via submitted CVs [CO-PROFILE].
